formatMoney takes cents, so a 2.005 coming through means a fractional cent reached it, probably from a line total that wasn't rounded first. Yes, by default. next/image with the default loader sends requests to /_next/image on our server, which fetches the remote image, resizes and converts it, and caches the result, so the first request for each size hits the Node process and later ones are served from cache. That's what the build check showed: the avatars resolved through /_next/image as image/webp. Action: no change needed; if you want to keep avatars off our server, I can switch them to a custom loader that uses the CDN's own resizing, or `unoptimized`.
